subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB679
title: Provides that parties that have caused a certain amount of greenhouse gas emissions are strictly liable to harmed parties for damages incurred as a result of extreme weather attributable to climate change or a climate disaster.
headline: SB 679 did not pass

claims.text: SB 679 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 679 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
